summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate) without running tests or committing. Changes: added Update container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py (prologue, algebra); translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update, building the prologue from q.prologue[0] on the empty-request path before the early exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py mirroring prepareQuery with _original_args; prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers prepare/apply, reuse, idempotence, initNs, initial bindings, direct evaluation, container shape, no-mutation via name+str snapshot, empty and declarations-only requests, and empty update strings. The processor's update method was left unchanged since it already passes non-string input through. Not verified: no tests were run and black was not run; line lengths were checked by scan only, and the new module has no lines over 88 columns.
